chain_words.nuance: requires care and skill to handle
has many interacting parts that are hard to follow
full of fine, carefully interlocking detail
twisted and needlessly difficult to follow
so confusing that one can lose the way

explanation: These words all describe difficulty in understanding or handling something, with different intensities, from a manageable challenge to an almost bewildering maze.

usage_notes.difference: 'Complicated' suggests many parts that are hard to handle; 'intricate' suggests fine, carefully interlocking detail.
